issues.title: Secure certificate padlock
issues.problem_statement: The padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after the domain is connected, and its issue still needs to be checked.

items.description: Customer opened the domain in an incognito window and the same error showed; the dashboard showed the domain as "Not connected".
evidence: Opened in incognito. Still the same error.
It says "Not connected" next to the domain.

items.description: Support explained that an old A record for the shop address, set up earlier by the customer's previous developer, was blocking the connection and had to be replaced with a CNAME record.
evidence: That old record is blocking the connection.

items.description: Customer deleted the old A record and added a CNAME record for the shop address using the target value from the FlexiFunnels domain settings, following support's guidance; the dashboard then showed the domain as connected and the address loaded.
evidence: I deleted the A record and added the CNAME. Saved.

items.description: Customer deleted the second record for www and added a CNAME for www with the same target value, following support's guidance, and confirmed that both the main address and the www version now load the funnel.
